digest.component_or_area: opt-in verify.* gates (gate_enabled, close gate, claim gate)
propositions: gate_enabled must raise ConfigError (chained from parse fault) on unreadable rebar.toml instead of returning GateState.UNREADABLE and proceeding silently
a claim operation must fail loudly with ConfigError before work begins when rebar.toml is malformed, leaving the ticket in open state
a close operation must fail loudly with ConfigError before acquiring the write lock when rebar.toml is malformed, leaving the ticket in in_progress state
GateState.UNREADABLE is removed as an unreachable state; ENABLED/DISABLED resolution and bool monkeypatch compatibility remain unchanged for existing consumers
the CLI main() boundary must catch and render ConfigError with clean stderr output and exit code 1, matching the posture for other configuration faults
